column2: That day, you...
stole the $$大邪神$$ armor $$封印$$ed in the church,
and carried it into $$マルコ$$'s room...
Using the forbidden $$大邪神$$ armor...
you tried to bring $$マルコ$$ before the $$異端審問官$$'s tribunal...!!
Because you...
meant to murder $$マルコ$$, who was in your way!!
But you never expected...
that $$セラフィム$$ would defend the $$罪$$ falsely laid against $$マルコ$$...
and atone for that $$罪$$ with his own death!
Their $$友情$$ rests entirely on self-sacrifice!!
That is why I resolved to lend them my strength!
And where, I ask, is $$マルコ$$'s personal benefit
in what $$マルコ$$ does?
Hmph! I will not be fooled by such nonsense!!
Hah! A white $$羽$$ $$奴隷$$ helping a black $$羽$$ like me is only natural!
Hey, $$マルコ$$, are we just going to let him go?
Trying to reform black $$羽$$ people was doomed from the start...
But after he sacrificed himself that much...
might he not also have been $$セラフィム$$'s close friend...
is that not possible!?
Hey, old man!
We know quite well that even among those with black $$羽$$,
there are wicked people worthy of being called close friends!
Y-you lot!
Ah! This old man is blushing!
Heehee... heeheehee...
Heehee!
Oh yes, $$ルピルピ$$... How are you feeling?
Lord $$ヨハネ$$, Lady $$ルピルピ$$ is already...
Yes! As you can see, I am completely recovered.
All right! Now that this underground organization is gone...
it is about time we continued our journey in search of armor information!
I-I too...
May I come along on that journey too!?
Well said, $$マルコ$$!!
Ah, no—Lord $$マルコ$$!!
I must remain here and rebuild the organization.
I cannot accompany you, but...
$$救世主$$, I beg you to look after my son.
That old man's pretty pushy, but all right!
(A white $$羽$$ person like me...)
(To call me his son...)
Um... if possible, could you take me along too!?
I am a soldier in this underground organization, so I think I could be of some help.
What will you do, $$救世主$$!?
Recruit her!
Do not recruit her!
Ah! Thank youuu! I ended up as the only one left in the organization,
and staying here alone with that old man...
Honestly, I really did not want to!!
$$デュナ$$ joined the party!
Aww! I have to stay here alone with that old man!?
Will my chastity... really be safe!?
